status.main_product: Drone services, IoT solutions, and asset inspections
status.scope_reason: The company explicitly provides drone-based asset inspections, aerial data collection, and surveillance services under its Aerocon brand.
status.evidence: According to official registry profiles and company publications, Aeronics Consultoria Private Limited is an active company based in Lucknow that specializes in drone services, IoT solutions, and asset inspections.

claims.claim: The company reports that its specialized competencies include deploying an 18 MP RGB payload on its micro category drones, as well as providing general survey, mapping, and LiDAR solutions.
The company reports that its micro-category drone platforms deliver a flight time of 40+ minutes and an operational range of 4 km.
The company reports offering "AI-driven analytics" and cloud-based data analytics as features within its asset inspection services, managing a portfolio of over 300 asset inspections.
claims.note: managing a portfolio of over 300 asset inspections as a feature within its asset inspection services

claims.claim: Aeronics Consultoria Private Limited (Aerocon) reports on its website that it operates with DGCA approval and holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001 certifications to ensure regulatory standard compliance.

The company reports completing over 2,500 total projects, which include more than 300 asset inspections, 500 survey mapping projects, and 1,500 surveillance missions for clients such as Indian Railways and municipal corporations.
claims.corrected: The company reports completing over 2,500 total projects, which include more than 300 asset inspections, 500 survey mapping projects, and 1,500 surveillance missions for clients such as IFFCO and municipal corporations.

claims.claim: The company reports performing more than 300 asset inspections and 500 survey mapping projects as part of over 2,500 total projects, counting Indian Railways and various Municipal Corporations among its trusted clients.
The company has recorded more than 300 asset inspection projects out of over 2,500 total executed projects, as stated on its official commercial platform.
Financial registry data states that the company generated less than ₹10 crore in total revenue for the financial year ending March 31, 2025.
claims.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Financial Registry data via Tracxn

claims.claim: Ministry of Corporate Affairs records show the company was incorporated on October 17, 2019, as a private limited entity with an authorised share capital of ₹10 Lakhs and a paid-up capital of ₹1 Lakh.
claims.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Company Registry data via Tracxn

claims.claim: A contract won by the company from the U P Irrigation Department (Mechanical) in September 2026 for the modernization of the Ch. Charan Singh Dumariyaganj Pump Canal in Siddharthnagar, Uttar Pradesh, valued at ₹75.6 Lakh, according to public procurement logs on Tenderkart.
claims.corrected: A contract won by the company from the U P Irrigation Department (Mechanical) in September 2026 for the Supply, Installation, Testing And Commissioning of IOT based monitoring system at Dumariyaganj Pump Canal in Siddharthnagar, Uttar Pradesh, valued at ₹75.6 Lakh, according to public procurement logs on Tenderkart.
claims.source: Public procurement logs via Tenderkart and BidEasy

claims.claim: A contract awarded to the company by the Directorate of Local Bodies UP in July 2026 for conducting aerial drone spray services across water bodies in the Lucknow Municipal Corporation areas of Uttar Pradesh, as detailed in listings on Tenderkart.

The company reports that it is trusted by and works with prominent institutional clients, including the Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO), Indian Railways, and multiple municipal corporations.
